description: Just to update, it is final stretch to November and I have great gratitude to Charlotte County Dems, North Port Dems, Venice Dems, and Sarasota Dems for giving me opportunity to meet voters, state my platform, and solicit input, support, and strategy to get it done. A lot of focus was on the primary races, but now that that has been decided, time to put all our effort into winning in November, up and down the ticket!
title: Hi Visitors, Voters, and Volunteers!
